Ethiopia's Tigray Region Sees Renewed Fighting Between TPLF and Federal Army

Clashes have erupted between the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) and the Ethiopian federal army in a contested area of the northern Tigray region. The fighting, which occurred near Sheraro, is seen as a significant threat to the 2022 Pretoria peace deal. Both sides are trading blame for the renewed hostilities. The previous war in Tigray, from 2020 to 2022, resulted in an estimated 600,000 deaths, and the region has not yet fully recovered.
